name: Suou Hitsuji
source:
Hitsuji is a first-year transfer student from Kyoto.

She gives off an unfriendly air, which she is well aware of. Bothered by the fact, she is left acting a bit meek and reserved.

On her first day at the Academy, Hitsuji messed up and kissed Alissa out of nowhere, which led to the two of them going out. She's been acting clingy and dependent towards her girlfriend ever since.

[Based on the description [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/2003051798001807440]provided by the author.[/url]]
